title: Flasque augmented tensor complexes across a scheme morphism
statement: Let $X,X'$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:X'\to X$ a morphism, and $F,G$ module sheaves on $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Equip both module categories with the additive tensor structure [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. There exist integer cochain complexes $K,L,M$ on $X$ and $K_1,L_1,M_1$ on $X'$, strictly zero in negative degrees, with flasque terms, and quasi-isomorphic augmentations $a,b,c,a_1,b_1,c_1$ from $F[0],G[0],(F\otimes G)[0],f^*F[0],f^*G[0],(f^*F\otimes f^*G)[0]$, respectively. Here $f^*$ is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and the tensor is the sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. There are tensor cochain maps $u:\operatorname{Tot}(K\otimes L)\to M$ and $u_1:\operatorname{Tot}(K_1\otimes L_1)\to M_1$ inducing the ordinary tensor of sections under the degree-zero augmentations. There are cochain maps $l:K\to f_*K_1$, $r:L\to f_*L_1$, $t:M\to f_*M_1$. Their degree-zero augmentation squares commute over the adjunction units $\eta_F,\eta_G$ and $f_*\tau\circ\eta_{F\otimes G}$, where $\tau:f^*(F\otimes G)\to f^*F\otimes f^*G$ is the section-normalized comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor]. For every $p,q\in\mathbf N$, every open $V\subseteq X$ and sections $x\in\Gamma(V,K^p)$, $y\in\Gamma(V,L^q)$, one has $t^{p+q}(u(\iota_{p,q}(x\otimes y)))=u_1(\iota_{p,q}(l^p(x)\otimes r^q(y)))$ as sections of $M_1^{p+q}$ on $f^{-1}V$. No injective comparison, computing resolution or cohomology-class equation is asserted.

proof.text: Obtain six augmented Godement models using models_exist on F,G,F tensor G and the three pulled-back coefficients. Take φ,ψ as the adjunction units and χ as the tensor unit followed by pushforward of the section-normalized tensor comparison. Its normalization proves the pure tensor compatibility hypothesis. Apply the generic Godement f-map summand lemma to these given models to obtain compatible μ,μ₁ and l,r,t with their augmentation squares.

For each of the six given models, model_quasiIso supplies the quasi-isomorphism and modelFlasque (the proved helper of cosimplicial_input) supplies termwise flasqueness. The extension-by-zero complex has IsStrictlyGE 0 by the Mathlib embedding support instance.

Use the proved aw_components construction in cosimplicial_aw_natural to obtain u and u₁ with components awComponent. The coproduct inclusion lemma identifies each inclusion followed by that component with awSummand. In bidegree (0,0), awSummand_zero identifies this with ZeroPair. Evaluate the two morphism equalities on the augmented pure tensor sections and compose with the zero-pair equations to prove the two augmentation clauses. In arbitrary nonnegative bidegree, evaluate the inclusion/component equations on both schemes; compose the first with t, apply the generic f-map summand equation, and compose with the reverse of the second. This proves the displayed section equality and assembles the existential witnesses.

theorem moduleCup_pullback_flasque_complexes (X X' : Scheme.{v}) (f : X' ⟶ X)
    [MonoidalPreadditive X.Modules] [MonoidalPreadditive X'.Modules] (F G : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (K L M : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
      (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶ K)
      (b : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj G ⟶ L)
      (c : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj (F ⊗ G) ⟶ M),
      QuasiIso a ∧ QuasiIso b ∧ QuasiIso c ∧
      K.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ L.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ M.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (K.X n))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (L.X n))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj (M.X n))) ∧
      ∃ u : HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K L ⟶ M,
        (∀ (V : X.Opens)
          (x : Γ(((CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F).X 0, V))
          (y : Γ(((CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj G).X 0, V)),
          (u.f 0).val.app (op V)
            ((HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj K L 0 0 0 (by simp)).val.app (op V)
              (tmulSection ((a.f 0).val.app (op V) x) ((b.f 0).val.app (op V) y))) =
            (c.f 0).val.app (op V) (tmulSection x y)) ∧
    ∃ (K₁ L₁ M₁ : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℤ)
      (a₁ : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj ((tensorPullback f).obj F) ⟶ K₁)
      (b₁ : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj ((tensorPullback f).obj G) ⟶ L₁)
      (c₁ : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj
        ((tensorPullback f).obj F ⊗ (tensorPullback f).obj G) ⟶ M₁),
      QuasiIso a₁ ∧ QuasiIso b₁ ∧ QuasiIso c₁ ∧
      K₁.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ L₁.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ M₁.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)).obj (K₁.X n))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)).obj (L₁.X n))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace)).obj (M₁.X n))) ∧
      ∃ u₁ : HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K₁ L₁ ⟶ M₁,
        (∀ (V : X'.Opens)
          (x : Γ(((CochainComplex.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj
            ((tensorPullback f).obj F)).X 0, V))
          (y : Γ(((CochainComplex.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj
            ((tensorPullback f).obj G)).X 0, V)),
          (u₁.f 0).val.app (op V)
            ((HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj K₁ L₁ 0 0 0 (by simp)).val.app (op V)
              (tmulSection ((a₁.f 0).val.app (op V) x) ((b₁.f 0).val.app (op V) y))) =
            (c₁.f 0).val.app (op V) (tmulSection x y)) ∧
        ∃ (l : K ⟶ ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K₁)
          (r : L ⟶ ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L₁)
          (t : M ⟶ ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M₁),
          a.f 0 ≫ l.f 0 =
            (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app F ≫
              (pushforward f).map (a₁.f 0) ∧
          b.f 0 ≫ r.f 0 =
            (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app G ≫
              (pushforward f).map (b₁.f 0) ∧
          c.f 0 ≫ t.f 0 =
            (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app (F ⊗ G) ≫
              (pushforward f).map ((Classical.choose (module_pullback_tensor f) F G).hom) ≫
              (pushforward f).map (c₁.f 0) ∧
          ∀ (p q : ℕ) (V : X.Opens)
            (x : Γ(K.X (p : ℤ), V)) (y : Γ(L.X (q : ℤ), V)),
            (t.f ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ)).val.app (op V)
              ((u.f _).val.app (op V)
                ((HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj K L (p : ℤ) (q : ℤ)
                  ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ) (by simp)).val.app (op V) (tmulSection x y))) =
            (u₁.f _).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
              ((HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj K₁ L₁ (p : ℤ) (q : ℤ)
                ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ) (by simp)).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
                  (tmulSection ((l.f (p : ℤ)).val.app (op V) x)
                    ((r.f (q : ℤ)).val.app (op V) y)))
